svg.title: Futuristic frontend developer workspace illustration
svg.desc: Isometric-style developer workspace with holographic UI panels, floating React code, neon purple and blue lighting, and a glowing laptop setup

rect.style: background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 4px);fill:none;stroke:none;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Anthropic Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto
